## Ingredients

- 1 egg yolk
- Olive oil
- ¼ lemon
- Johnny’s Seasoning Salt
- Black pepper
- Tabasco or other hot sauce
- Dijon mustard
- Anchovy paste
- Red wine vinegar
- Worcestershire sauce
- Garlic

## Instructions

1. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together egg yolk, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, anchovy paste, red wine vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, hot sauce, seasoning salt, and black pepper.
2. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking until the dressing thickens and emulsifies.
3. Adjust seasoning to taste and serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to use.
